name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track but in the stands. As a child, he was captivated by the strategic precision of pit stops and the intricate teamwork required to keep a racing team running smoothly. This fascination led him to pursue a degree in Human Resources, always with the goal of applying his skills in the high-octane world of racing.

Before joining Racing Start Academy, Park honed his HR skills at a tech startup known for its rapid growth and demanding environment. He specializes in talent acquisition and development, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment where every team member can thrive. His meticulous approach to employee relations ensures that the team operates at peak performance, both on and off the track.

What sets Park apart is his passion for data-driven decision-making in HR. He constantly analyzes employee performance metrics and feedback to identify areas for improvement and implement innovative strategies to enhance team cohesion and productivity. He believes a happy team is a winning team.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly parted to the side with a slight wave
physical.description: Park has a focused gaze and a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Starts every Monday morning with a team-building puzzle or brain teaser.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his desk, each representing a significant team achievement.
